"Create a premium 3D Android racing game called ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026.

PLATFORM:
Android smartphones only.

GAME ORIENTATION:
Landscape mode.

GAME ENGINE:
Use a suitable real-time 3D game engine such as Unity or Godot. Do not create a static website and call it a game.

GRAPHICS:

- Realistic 3D graphics.
- HD environments.
- Realistic car reflections.
- Dynamic shadows.
- Realistic roads.
- Day and night cycles.
- Rain and weather effects.

GAMEPLAY:

- Fully functional driving controls.
- Steering buttons.
- Acceleration and braking.
- Nitro boost.
- Realistic drifting.
- Car collisions.
- AI racing opponents.
- Multiple racing tracks.

GAME MODES:

- Career mode.
- Quick race.
- Free driving.
- Drift challenge.
- Police chase.
- Tournament mode.
- Multiplayer (future update).

CARS:
Start with 10 unique sports cars and supercars.

ENVIRONMENTS:

- Modern city.
- Mountain highway.
- Desert road.
- Coastal highway.
- Night racing city.

GARAGE:
Allow players to select vehicles, change colours, upgrade engines, customize wheels and improve performance.

MOBILE OPTIMIZATION:

- Support different Android screen sizes.
- Low, medium, high and ultra graphics.
- 30 FPS and 60 FPS options.
- Optimize memory usage.
- Smooth gameplay on affordable Android phones.

DELIVERY:
Create a playable prototype first.
Provide the complete project source code and instructions for building an Android APK and Google Play Store AAB.

All buttons must work. The player must be able to select a car, start a race, drive, finish races and earn rewards.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

extends Node3D

const CAR_SCRIPT = preload("res://scripts/car.gd")
const MODES := ["QUICK RACE", "CAREER", "FREE DRIVE", "DRIFT CHALLENGE", "POLICE CHASE", "TOURNAMENT", "MULTIPLAYER"]
const TRACKS := ["NEON HARBOR", "ALPINE PASS", "DUST DEVIL", "PACIFIC RUN", "AFTER HOURS"]
const CARS := [
	{"name":"VORTEX GT", "class":"SPORT", "speed":66.0, "accel":26.0, "handling":1.0, "color":"#db4e45", "price":0},
	{"name":"NOVA R8", "class":"SUPERCAR", "speed":76.0, "accel":29.0, "handling":0.96, "color":"#35a8c8", "price":1800},
	{"name":"FALCON XR", "class":"MUSCLE", "speed":70.0, "accel":31.0, "handling":0.82, "color":"#e8aa45", "price":2400},
	{"name":"ZENITH S", "class":"HYPER", "speed":84.0, "accel":31.0, "handling":1.04, "color":"#d5d9df", "price":3800},
	{"name":"NIGHTSHADE", "class":"SPORT", "speed":73.0, "accel":27.0, "handling":1.12, "color":"#7657b9", "price":3200},
	{"name":"TORQUE RS", "class":"RALLY", "speed":68.0, "accel":29.0, "handling":1.22, "color":"#68ad72", "price":2800},
	{"name":"APEX V12", "class":"HYPER", "speed":88.0, "accel":32.0, "handling":0.93, "color":"#f0e5d6", "price":6200},
	{"name":"ECLIPSE GT", "class":"SPORT", "speed":74.0, "accel":28.0, "handling":1.1, "color":"#e56ca3", "price":3600},
	{"name":"BLAZE 900", "class":"SUPERCAR", "speed":81.0, "accel":30.0, "handling":1.02, "color":"#ef7646", "price":5200},
	{"name":"PHANTOM Z", "class":"HYPER", "speed":91.0, "accel":33.0, "handling":0.98, "color":"#4d637f", "price":8500}
]
const PAINTS := ["#db4e45", "#35a8c8", "#e8aa45", "#d5d9df", "#7657b9", "#68ad72", "#f0e5d6", "#e56ca3", "#ef7646", "#4d637f"]

var save := ConfigFile.new()
var credits := 2500
var owned := [0]
var selected_car := 0
var selected_track := 0
var selected_mode := 0
var engine_level := 0
var paint_index := 0
var wheel_style := 0
var quality := 1
var target_fps := 60
var night := false
var rainy := false
var racing := false
var elapsed := 0.0
var race_time := 0.0
var drift_score := 0
var race_progress := 0
var lap := 1
var laps_total := 3
var player: StreetCar
var opponents: Array[StreetCar] = []
var route: Array[Vector3] = []
var route_index := 0
var camera: Camera3D
var ui: CanvasLayer
var menu_root: Control
var race_hud: Control
var message_label: Label
var speed_label: Label
var nitro_bar: ProgressBar
var touch_values := {"left":false,"right":false,"gas":false,"brake":false,"nitro":false,"drift":false}
var style := {}
var last_drift := false
var career_races := 0
var best_time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	_load_progress()
	_build_environment()
	_build_track()
	_build_ui()
	_show_home()
	Input.set_mouse_mode(Input.MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE)

func _load_progress() -> void:
	if save.load("user://progress.cfg") == OK:
		credits = int(save.get_value("profile", "credits", credits))
		owned = save.get_value("profile", "owned", owned)
		selected_car = int(save.get_value("profile", "car", 0))
		engine_level = int(save.get_value("profile", "engine", 0))
		paint_index = int(save.get_value("profile", "paint", 0))
		career_races = int(save.get_value("profile", "career", 0))
		best_time = float(save.get_value("profile", "best", 0.0))
	selected_car = clampi(selected_car, 0, CARS.size() - 1)
	if not owned.has(0): owned.append(0)

func _save_progress() -> void:
	save.set_value("profile", "credits", credits)
	save.set_value("profile", "owned", owned)
	save.set_value("profile", "car", selected_car)
	save.set_value("profile", "engine", engine_level)
	save.set_value("profile", "paint", paint_index)
	save.set_value("profile", "career", career_races)
	save.set_value("profile", "best", best_time)
	save.save("user://progress.cfg")

func _build_environment() -> void:
	var world := WorldEnvironment.new()
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky := Sky.new()
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color("#101a37") if night else Color("#4779a1")
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color("#e18c65") if night else Color("#c8ddeb")
	sky_mat.ground_bottom_color = Color("#111722")
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color("#536070")
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
	env.ambient_light_color = Color("#8fa6cd") if night else Color("#d0deef")
	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.65 if night else 0.9
	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
	env.reflection_source = Environment.REFLECTION_SOURCE_BG
	world.environment = env
	add_child(world)
	var sun := DirectionalLight3D.new()
	sun.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48, -32, 0) if not night else Vector3(-22, 38, 0)
	sun.light_color = Color("#ffd4ad") if not night else Color("#8eb6ff")
	sun.light_energy = 1.15 if not night else 0.38
	sun.shadow_enabled = true
	sun.directional_shadow_max_distance = 180.0
	add_child(sun)

func _build_track() -> void:
	for child in get_children():
		if child.name.begins_with("Track_") or child.name == "Scenery": child.queue_free()
	var root := Node3D.new()
	root.name = "Track_" + TRACKS[selected_track]
	add_child(root)
	var ground := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var plane := PlaneMesh.new()
	plane.size = Vector2(280, 220)
	ground.mesh = plane
	ground.position.y = -0.5
	ground.material_override = _mat(Color("#253a32") if selected_track != 2 else Color("#74634c"), 0.05, 0.9)
	root.add_child(ground)
	route.clear()
	var points := 192
	var rx := 80.0
	var rz := 50.0
	if selected_track == 1: rz = 58.0
	if selected_track == 2: rx = 88.0; rz = 44.0
	if selected_track == 3: rx = 90.0; rz = 50.0
	if selected_track == 4: rx = 75.0; rz = 46.0
	for i in range(points):
		var a := TAU * float(i) / float(points)
		var zmod := sin(a * 2.0) * (5.0 if selected_track == 1 else 2.5)
		route.append(Vector3(rx * cos(a), 0, rz * sin(a) + zmod))
	_add_road(root)
	_add_props(root)

func _add_road(root: Node3D) -> void:
	var road_mesh := _ribbon_mesh(7.5, 0.02)
	var road := MeshInstance3D.new()
	road.mesh = road_mesh
	road.material_override = _mat(Color("#30363d") if not night else Color("#202532"), 0.25, 0.38)
	root.add_child(road)
	var edge := MeshInstance3D.new()
	edge.mesh = _ribbon_mesh(8.0, 0.0)
	edge.material_override = _mat(Color("#e4e6df"), 0.0, 0.8)
	root.add_child(edge)
	var center_line := MeshInstance3D.new()
	center_line.mesh = _ribbon_mesh(0.13, 0.045)
	center_line.material_override = _mat(Color("#d7c88f"), 0.0, 0.6)
	root.add_child(center_line)
	# Repeating reflective safety barriers define the drivable course and collide with cars.
	for side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		for i in range(0, route.size(), 4):
			var tangent := (route[(i + 1) % route.size()] - route[(i - 1 + route.size()) % route.size()]).normalized()
			var lateral := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x) * side * 8.6
			var pos := route[i] + lateral + Vector3.UP * 0.58
			var barrier := StaticBody3D.new()
			barrier.position = pos
			barrier.rotation.y = atan2(tangent.x, tangent.z)
			barrier.collision_layer = 1
			barrier.collision_mask = 2
			var box := BoxShape3D.new()
			box.size = Vector3(0.35, 1.15, 5.2)
			var col := CollisionShape3D.new()
			col.shape = box
			barrier.add_child(col)
			var visual := MeshInstance3D.new()
			var bm := BoxMesh.new()
			bm.size = box.size
			visual.mesh = bm
			visual.material_override = _mat(Color("#9faab4") if i % 8 < 4 else Color("#e35e50"), 0.55, 0.35)
			barrier.add_child(visual)
			root.add_child(barrier)

func _ribbon_mesh(width: float, y: float) -> ArrayMesh:
	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
	for i in range(route.size()):
		var p0: Vector3 = route[i]
		var p1: Vector3 = route[(i + 1) % route.size()]
		var tangent := (p1 - p0).normalized()
		var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x) * width
		var a := p0 + side + Vector3.UP * y
		var b := p0 - side + Vector3.UP * y
		var c := p1 + side + Vector3.UP * y
		var d := p1 - side + Vector3.UP * y
		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(a); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c)
		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(d)
	st.generate_normals()
	return st.commit()

return st.commit()

func _add_props(root: Node3D) -> void:
	var scenery := Node3D.new()
	scenery.name = "Scenery"
	root.add_child(scenery)
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = 101 + selected_track * 53
	var colors := [Color("#394653"), Color("#505b68"), Color("#66727a"), Color("#333c4c")]
	for i in range(84):
		var a := TAU * float(i) / 84.0 + rng.randf_range(-0.035, 0.035)
		var r := rng.randf_range(15.0, 27.0)
		var side := -1.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 1.0
		var pos := Vector3((80.0 + r) * cos(a), 0, (50.0 + r) * sin(a))
		if selected_track == 2:
			pos += Vector3(12.0 * cos(a), 0, 4.0 * sin(a))
		var height := rng.randf_range(5.0, 19.0) if selected_track == 0 or selected_track == 4 else rng.randf_range(2.0, 8.0)
		var width := rng.randf_range(5.0, 10.0)
		var building := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var box := BoxMesh.new()
		box.size = Vector3(width, height, rng.randf_range(5.0, 10.0))
		building.mesh = box
		building.position = pos + Vector3(0, height * 0.5 - 0.1, 0)
		building.material_override = _mat(colors[rng.randi_range(0, colors.size() - 1)], 0.25, 0.72)
		scenery.add_child(building)
		if night and i % 2 == 0:
			var windows := MeshInstance3D.new()
			var window_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
			window_mesh.size = Vector3(width * 0.72, 0.11, 0.08)
			windows.mesh = window_mesh
			windows.position = building.position + Vector3(0, rng.randf_range(-height * 0.3, height * 0.3), box.size.z * 0.5 + 0.06)
			windows.material_override = _mat(Color("#ffcf78"), 0.1, 0.28, 1.5)
			scenery.add_child(windows)
	# Streetlights frame the course at night, coastal and urban locations.
	if night or selected_track == 0 or selected_track == 3:
		for i in range(0, route.size(), 12):
			var p: Vector3 = route[i]
			var tangent := (route[(i + 1) % route.size()] - route[(i - 1 + route.size()) % route.size()]).normalized()
			var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x)
			for sign_side in [-1.0, 1.0]:
				var pole := MeshInstance3D.new()
				var pole_mesh := CylinderMesh.new()
				pole_mesh.top_radius = 0.08
				pole_mesh.bottom_radius = 0.12
				pole_mesh.height = 7.0
				pole.mesh = pole_mesh
				pole.position = p + side * sign_side * 11.0 + Vector3.UP * 3.5
				pole.material_override = _mat(Color("#333a47"), 0.6, 0.4)
				scenery.add_child(pole)
				var lamp := MeshInstance3D.new()
				var lm := BoxMesh.new()
				lm.size = Vector3(0.65, 0.16, 0.3)
				lamp.mesh = lm
				lamp.position = pole.position + Vector3.UP * 3.5 + side * -sign_side * 1.0

		parent.add_child(wheel)

func _prev_car() -> void:
	selected_car = (selected_car - 1 + CARS.size()) % CARS.size()
	_show_garage()

func _next_car() -> void:
	selected_car = (selected_car + 1) % CARS.size()
	_show_garage()

func _buy_car() -> void:
	var cost := int(CARS[selected_car].price)
	if not owned.has(selected_car) and credits >= cost:
		credits -= cost
		owned.append(selected_car)
		_save_progress()
	_show_garage()

func _cycle_paint() -> void:
	paint_index = (paint_index + 1) % PAINTS.size()
	_save_progress()
	_show_garage()

func _upgrade_engine() -> void:
	var cost := 900 + engine_level * 650
	if engine_level < 4 and credits >= cost:
		credits -= cost
		engine_level += 1
		_save_progress()
	_show_garage()

func _cycle_wheels() -> void:
	wheel_style = (wheel_style + 1) % 4
	_show_garage()

func _cycle_mode() -> void:
	selected_mode = (selected_mode + 1) % MODES.size()
	_show_home()

func _cycle_track() -> void:
	selected_track = (selected_track + 1) % TRACKS.size()
	_build_track()
	_show_home()

func _cycle_quality() -> void:
	quality = (quality + 1) % 4
	_show_settings()

func _cycle_fps() -> void:
	target_fps = 30 if target_fps == 60 else 60
	Engine.max_fps = target_fps
	_show_settings()

func _toggle_night() -> void:
	night = not night
	for child in get_children():
		if child is WorldEnvironment or child is DirectionalLight3D: child.queue_free()
	_build_environment()
	_build_track()
	_show_settings()

func _toggle_weather() -> void:
	rainy = not rainy
	if menu_root.visible: _show_home()

func _toggle_weather() -> void:
	rainy = not rainy
	if menu_root.visible: _show_home()

func _start_race() -> void:
	if selected_mode == 6:
		_show_future()
		return
	for actor in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("race_cars"):
		actor.queue_free()
	opponents.clear()
	elapsed = 0.0
	race_time = 0.0
	drift_score = 0
	race_progress = 0
	race_index = 0
	lap = 1
	laps_total = 1 if selected_mode == 2 or selected_mode == 3 else 3
	last_drift = false
	_build_track()
	var data: Dictionary = CARS[selected_car]
	player = CAR_SCRIPT.new()
	player.name = "PlayerCar"
	player.car_name = data.name
	player.max_speed = float(data.speed) + engine_level * 3.5
	player.acceleration = float(data.accel) + engine_level * 1.8
	player.handling = float(data.handling)
	player.is_player = true
	player.set_paint(Color(PAINTS[paint_index]))
	player.add_to_group("race_cars")
	add_child(player)
	_place_car(player, 0, 0.0)
	var colors := ["#45a9ca", "#e9b64d", "#a878d0", "#70c28a", "#e47663"]
	for i in range(5):
		var rival: StreetCar = CAR_SCRIPT.new()
		rival.name = "Rival_%d" % (i + 1)
		rival.car_name = ["KAI", "MILA", "REX", "JUNO", "ASH"][i]
		rival.max_speed = float(data.speed) * (0.72 + i * 0.025)
		rival.acceleration = float(data.accel) * 0.84
		rival.handling = float(data.handling) * 0.88
		rival.set_paint(Color(colors[i]))
		rival.add_to_group("race_cars")
		add_child(rival)
		_place_car(rival, 0, float(i + 1) * 2.3 * (-1.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 1.0), -6.0 - float(i / 2) * 4.0)
		opponents.append(rival)
	_create_camera()
	_build_race_hud()
	menu_root.visible = false
	race_hud.visible = true
	race_hud.move_to_front()
	race_hud.set_process(true)
	racing = true
	race_paused = false
	if rainy: _create_rain()
	if selected_mode == 0 or selected_mode == 1 or selected_mode == 5:
		message_label.text = "3   ·   GET READY"
	else:
		message_label.text = MODES[selected_mode]
	message_label.visible = true

func _show_future() -> void:
	_clear_menu()
	var bg := ColorRect.new(); bg.color = Color("#09121e"); bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT); menu_root.add_child(bg)
	_header(menu_root, "COMING IN A FUTURE UPDATE", "THE GRID IS GROWING", "Multiplayer matchmaking is planned. The complete local racing prototype is ready now.")
	_panel(menu_root, Rect2(76, 195, 1128, 412))
	_label(menu_root, "ONLINE RACING", Vector2(118, 258), Vector2(400, 40), 27, Color("#f4f3ef"), true)
	_label(menu_root, "Choose any other mode to race against five AI drivers, explore the course, tune your garage, and earn credits.", Vector2(118, 315), Vector2(880, 55), 17, Color("#b9c3cf"))
	_button(menu_root, "BACK TO THE GRID", Rect2(118, 438, 320, 58), _show_home, true)

func _place_car(car: StreetCar, point_index: int, lane: float, behind := 0.0) -> void:
	var index := posmod(point_index, route.size())
	var point: Vector3 = route[index]
	var tangent := (route[(index + 1) % route.size()] - route[(index - 1 + route.size()) % route.size()]).normalized()
	var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x)
	car.global_position = point + side * lane - tangent * behind + Vector3.UP * 0.25
	car.rotation.y = atan2(-tangent.x, -tangent.z)

func _create_camera() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(camera): camera.queue_free()
	camera = Camera3D.new()
	camera.current = true
	camera.fov = 72.0
	camera.near = 0.1
	camera.far = 500.0
	add_child(camera)
	camera.global_position = player.global_position + Vector3(0, 6, 12)
	camera.look_at(player.global_position + Vector3(0, 1, 0), Vector3.UP)

func _build_race_hud() -> void:
	for child in race_hud.get_children():
		if child != message_label: child.queue_free()
	_panel(race_hud, Rect2(24, 20, 250, 94), Color(0.025,0.04,0.07,0.8))
	_label(race_hud, TRACKS[selected_track] + "  /  " + MODES[selected_mode], Vector2(44, 36), Vector2(230, 20), 12, Color("#ff9d73"), true)
	_label(race_hud, "LAP", Vector2(44, 65), Vector2(40, 20), 12, Color("#93a1b2"))
	var lap_label := _label(race_hud, "1 / %d" % laps_total, Vector2(86, 59), Vector2(110, 30), 20, Color("#f2f1ed"), true)
	lap_label.name = "LapLabel"
	var time_label := _label(race_hud, "00:00.000", Vector2(44, 88), Vector2(160, 20), 12, Color("#c0cad5"))
	time_label.name = "TimeLabel"
	var rank_label := _label(race_hud, "1ST / 6", Vector2(1072, 34), Vector2(160, 33), 22, Color("#f1f0ec"), true)
	rank_label.name = "RankLabel"
	_panel(race_hud, Rect2(1020, 20, 232, 95), Color(0.025,0.04,0.07,0.8))
	var sp := _label(race_hud, "000", Vector2(1062, 53), Vector2(110, 48), 36, Color("#f4f3ef"), true)
	sp.name = "SpeedLabel"
	_label(race_hud, "KM/H", Vector2(1164, 69), Vector2(60, 20), 11, Color("#91a0b0"))
	var nitro_title := _label(race_hud, "NITRO", Vector2(1055, 92), Vector2(48, 16), 10, Color("#72d6f1"), true)
	var bar := ProgressBar.new()
	bar.position = Vector2(1100, 93); bar.size = Vector2(128, 12); bar.max_value = 100; bar.value = 100; bar.show_percentage = false
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("fill", _bar_style(Color("#5bc9e9")))
	bar.add_theme_stylebox_override("background", _bar_style(Color("#1b2b3a")))
	bar.name = "NitroBar"
	race_hud.add_child(bar)
	for child in race_hud.get_children():
		if child is Label and child.text.begins_with("000"): speed_label = child
	nitro_bar = bar
	var pause := _button(race_hud, "Ⅱ", Rect2(1192, 132, 58, 46), _pause_race)
	pause.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	_add_touch_controls()

func _bar_style(color: Color) -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var box := StyleBoxFlat.new(); box.bg_color = color; box.set_corner_radius_all(5); return box

func _add_touch_controls() -> void:
	_touch_button("◀", Rect2(24, 0, 92, 82), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2(24, -106), "left")
	_touch_button("▶", Rect2(24, 0, 92, 82), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2(128, -106), "right")
	_touch_button("BRAKE", Rect2(24, 0, 88, 64), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(-232, -91), "brake")
	_touch_button("DRIFT", Rect2(24, 0, 88, 64), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(-332, -91), "drift")
	_touch_button("NITRO", Rect2(24, 0, 108, 72), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(-132, -183), "nitro")
	_touch_button("ACCEL", Rect2(24, 0, 132, 92), Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(-152, -84), "gas", true)

func _touch_button(text: String, rect: Rect2, anchor: Vector2, offset: Vector2, key: String, accent := false) -> void:
	var button := Button.new()
	button.text = text
	button.anchor_left = anchor.x; button.anchor_right = anchor.x
	button.anchor_top = anchor.y; button.anchor_bottom = anchor.y
	button.offset_left = offset.x; button.offset_top = offset.y
	button.offset_right = offset.x + rect.size.x; button.offset_bottom = offset.y + rect.size.y
	button.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
	button.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16 if not accent else 18)
	var sb := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	sb.bg_color = Color(0.08,0.12,0.17,0.78) if not accent else Color(0.83,0.27,0.19,0.86)
	sb.border_color = Color(0.64,0.73,0.83,0.45); sb.set_border_width_all(1); sb.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", sb)
	button.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", _bar_style(Color(0.28,0.37,0.46,0.9)))
	button.button_down.connect(func(): touch_values[key] = true)
	button.button_up.connect(func(): touch_values[key] = false)
	race_hud.add_child(button)

func _pause_race() -> void:
	if not racing: return
	race_paused = true
	for child in race_hud.get_children():
		if child.name == "PauseOverlay": child.queue_free()

+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not racing: return
+	if race_paused:
+		if is_instance_valid(player):
+			player.throttle = 0.0; player.steer = 0.0; player.braking = true; player.using_nitro = false
+		return
+	elapsed += delta
+	race_time += delta
+	var steer_input := float(touch_values.left) * -1.0 + float(touch_values.right)
+	var gas_input := float(touch_values.gas)
+	var brake_input := bool(touch_values.brake)
+	var nitro_input := bool(touch_values.nitro)
+	var drift_input := bool(touch_values.drift)
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A): steer_input -= 1.0
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D): steer_input += 1.0
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W): gas_input = 1.0
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_S): brake_input = true
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE): drift_input = true
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT): nitro_input = true
+	if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_ESCAPE) and not escape_latch:
+		escape_latch = true
+		_pause_race()
+	if not Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_ESCAPE): escape_latch = false
+	player.throttle = gas_input
+	player.steer = clampf(steer_input, -1.0, 1.0)
+	player.braking = brake_input
+	player.drifting = drift_input
+	player.using_nitro = nitro_input
+	if player.speed > 13.0 and drift_input and absf(steer_input) > 0.25:
+		drift_score += int(delta * absf(steer_input) * player.speed * 0.9)
+	if player.speed < 4.0: drift_score = maxi(0, drift_score - 1)
+	_update_ai(delta)
+	_update_camera(delta)
+	_update_race_progress(delta)
+	_update_hud()
+	if selected_mode == 2 and int(race_time) > 0 and int(race_time) % 70 == 0 and int(race_time - delta) % 70 != 0:
+		credits += 75
+		_save_progress()
+		message_label.text = "+75 CR  ·  OPEN ROAD BONUS"
+		message_label.visible = true
+	elif elapsed > 1.7 and message_label.text.contains("GET READY"):
+		message_label.visible = false
+	if laps_total > 0 and race_progress >= route.size() * laps_total and selected_mode != 2:
+		_finish_race()
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and not event.echo and racing and not race_paused:
+		_pause_race()
+
+func _update_ai(delta: float) -> void:
+	for i in range(opponents.size()):
+		var rival := opponents[i]
+		if not is_instance_valid(rival): continue
+		var target: Vector3
+		if selected_mode == 4 and i == 0:
+			target = player.global_position
+		else:
+			var nearest := _nearest_route_point(rival.global_position)
+			var target_i := posmod(nearest + 6, route.size())
+			var tangent := (route[(target_i + 1) % route.size()] - route[(target_i - 1 + route.size()) % route.size()]).normalized()
+			var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x)
+			target = route[target_i] + side * float(i - 2) * 1.35
+		var direction := (target - rival.global_position).normalized()
+		var forward := -rival.global_transform.basis.z
+		var angle := forward.signed_angle_to(direction, Vector3.UP)
+		rival.steer = clampf(angle * 2.3, -1.0, 1.0)
+		rival.throttle = 1.0
+		rival.braking = absf(angle) > 0.95 and rival.speed > 20.0
+		rival.drifting = absf(angle) > 0.45
+		rival.using_nitro = rival.speed < rival.max_speed * 0.7 and i == 0
+		if selected_mode == 4 and i == 0:
+			rival.using_nitro = rival.global_position.distance_to(player.global_position) > 20.0
+
+func _nearest_route_point(position: Vector3) -> int:
+	var best := 0
+	var best_distance := INF
+	for i in range(route.size()):
+		var d := Vector2(position.x - route[i].x, position.z - route[i].z).length_squared()
+		if d < best_distance:
+			best_distance = d
+			best = i
+	return best
+
+func _update_camera(delta: float) -> void:
+	var forward := -player.global_transform.basis.z
+	var target_position := player.global_position - forward * 11.0 + Vector3.UP * 5.2
+	camera.global_position = camera.global_position.lerp(target_position, 1.0 - exp(-5.5 * delta))
+	camera.look_at(player.global_position + forward * 5.0 + Vector3.UP * 1.0, Vector3.UP)
+
+func _update_race_progress(delta: float) -> void:
+	var nearest := _nearest_route_point(player.global_position)
+	var step := (nearest - route_index + route.size()) % route.size()
+	if step < route.size() / 4:
+		race_progress += step
+	elif step > route.size() * 3 / 4:
+		race_progress = maxi(0, race_progress - (route.size() - step))
+	race_index = nearest
+	lap = mini(laps_total, int(race_progress / route.size()) + 1)
+	if selected_mode == 2:
+		race_progress = maxi(race_progress, nearest)
+		lap = 1
+
+func _update_hud() -> void:

+	var time_label := race_hud.find_child("TimeLabel", true, false) as Label
+	var rank_label := race_hud.find_child("RankLabel", true, false) as Label
+	var speed := race_hud.find_child("SpeedLabel", true, false) as Label
+	if is_instance_valid(lap_label):
+		if selected_mode == 2: lap_label.text = "OPEN"
+		elif selected_mode == 3: lap_label.text = "DRIFT"
+		else: lap_label.text = "%d / %d" % [lap, laps_total]
+	if is_instance_valid(time_label): time_label.text = _format_time(race_time) + ("   ·   %d PTS" % drift_score if selected_mode == 3 else "")
+	if is_instance_valid(speed): speed.text = "%03d" % int(absf(player.speed) * 3.6)
+	if is_instance_valid(rank_label): rank_label.text = "%s  /  6" % _player_rank()
+	if is_instance_valid(nitro_bar): nitro_bar.value = player.nitro
+
+func _player_rank() -> String:
+	var ahead := 0
+	var player_score := race_progress + _nearest_route_point(player.global_position) * 0.001
+	for rival in opponents:

## Objective
- Build a complete playable prototype of **ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026** using a real-time 3D game engine, with Android landscape support and instructions for APK/AAB builds.

## Requirements
- Android smartphones only; landscape orientation.
- Real-time 3D game, not a static website.
- Driving controls, AI opponents, multiple tracks, race completion and rewards.
- Garage with 10 cars, paint, engine upgrades, wheels, and performance improvements.
- Modes: career, quick race, free drive, drift challenge, police chase, tournament; multiplayer may be a future update.
- Settings for graphics presets and 30/60 FPS; support varied Android devices.
- Deliver complete source and Android APK/Google Play AAB build instructions.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer for a mobile-oriented 3D prototype.
- Build vehicles and environments procedurally from Godot meshes; no external assets have been added.
- Multiplayer is presented as a future update rather than implemented online.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial Godot project and main scene.
- Added procedural car script with acceleration, steering, braking, nitro, drifting, and collisions.
- Added substantial main game script with menus, garage, tracks, weather/night settings, race HUD, touch controls, AI, career save data, and reward logic.

### Active
- Validate and fix scripts/project; the current `scripts/main.gd` is incomplete and has likely errors.
- Complete race finishing, rain, app controls, and build documentation.
- Test gameplay and Android exports.

### Blocked
- Godot executable was not found in the environment (`which godot || which godot4` returned no output), so no project validation or gameplay capture has occurred.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and repair `scripts/main.gd`, especially its current end-of-file and any misspelled identifiers.
2. Finish race lifecycle, finish/results, and weather logic; verify all UI controls and interactions.
3. Run/import/test with Godot 4 if available, then address parser and runtime errors.
4. Add README instructions for desktop prototype play and Android APK/AAB export, including required Godot Android export templates/SDK setup.
5. Capture and inspect a current gameplay screenshot if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `project.godot`: Godot project configuration and landscape/mobile-compatible renderer settings.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene referencing the gameplay script.
- `scripts/main.gd`: Main game flow, menus, track/environment generation, race UI, input, and AI; currently unfinished.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural 3D car and driving physics prototype.
- `README.md`: Existing generic project README; should be replaced or expanded with game/build instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `scripts/main.gd` currently ends after `_player_rank()`; `_finish_race()` and `_create_rain()` were planned but not added.
- `_start_race()` references `escape_latch`, which has not been declared.
- `_quit_race()` calls `_race_cleanup()`; the cleanup function exists, but verify naming and race state logic.
- The prototype has procedural shapes rather than realistic authored assets; do not describe it as production-quality realistic graphics.

## Objective
- Build a playable 3D Android landscape racing prototype called ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026 using Godot, with source code and Android APK/AAB build instructions.

## Requirements
- Real-time 3D game for Android smartphones in landscape orientation.
- Driving controls, AI rivals, multiple tracks, race completion and rewards.
- 10 cars, paint and engine upgrades, wheel customization, and garage.
- Career, quick race, free drive, drift challenge, police chase, tournament; multiplayer may be a future update.
- Graphics presets and 30/60 FPS options; support varied Android devices.
- Provide complete source and APK/Google Play AAB build instructions.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer.
- Generate vehicles and environments procedurally; no external assets have been added.
- Present multiplayer as a future update, not implemented online.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added initial Godot project configuration and main scene.
- Added procedural car script with driving, nitro, drifting, and collision behavior.
- Added substantial `scripts/main.gd` implementation for generated tracks and scenery, menus, garage, settings, touch controls, AI, HUD, and partial race flow.

### Active
- Repair and finish `scripts/main.gd`; it currently ends after `_player_rank()`, without `_finish_race()` or `_create_rain()`.
- Validate menu interactions, race lifecycle, weather, and progression; fix known identifiers and state issues.
- Add desktop and Android build instructions to `README.md`.

### Blocked
- Godot validation and gameplay capture have not been performed because no `godot` or `godot4` executable was found.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and repair `scripts/main.gd`: declare `escape_latch`, fix `race_index`/`route_index` mismatch, and implement race completion and rain effects.
2. Review race progress, AI ranking, pause/results cleanup, and touch controls for runtime issues.
3. Install or locate Godot 4 if available; run/import the project and resolve parser and runtime errors.
4. Replace or expand `README.md` with desktop play and Android APK/AAB export setup instructions.
5. Capture and inspect a gameplay screenshot if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/main.gd`: Main game flow, menus, environment, race logic, and UI; unfinished.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural car construction and driving behavior.
- `project.godot`: Godot project and renderer/display configuration.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene referencing the gameplay script.
- `README.md`: Still generic; needs game and build instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `scripts/main.gd` references undeclared `escape_latch`; `_update_race_progress()` assigns `race_index` while the declared variable is `route_index`.
- Race completion and `_create_rain()` were planned but were not present at the latest inspection.

- Build a playable 3D Android landscape racing prototype called ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026 using Godot, with source code and Android APK/AAB build instructions.

## Requirements
- Real-time 3D Android game with driving controls, AI rivals, multiple tracks, race completion and rewards.
- 10 cars, paint and engine upgrades, wheel customization, garage, and several game modes.
- Graphics and frame-rate settings; multiplayer is a future update.
- Provide desktop play and Android APK/Google Play AAB build instructions.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer.
- Generate vehicles and environments procedurally; no external assets have been added.
- Present multiplayer as a future update, not implemented online.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created Godot project setup, main scene, procedural car and environment, menus, garage, settings, touch controls, AI, and HUD.
- Added race countdown, pause/resume input handling, opponent progress tracking, a race results/reward screen, and a procedural rain effect in `scripts/main.gd`.
- Fixed the route progress variable mismatch and added a track-floor collision body.

### Active
- Validate race lifecycle, ranking, mode-specific behavior, pause/results cleanup, and touch controls; inspect recent `scripts/main.gd` edits for runtime issues.
- Write desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions in `README.md`.

### Blocked
- Godot validation and gameplay capture have not been performed; no `godot` or `godot4` executable was found.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `scripts/main.gd` for syntax/runtime issues, especially race progress, countdown, results cleanup, and mode flow.
2. Run/import the project with Godot 4 when available and fix parser or runtime errors.
3. Update `README.md` with desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions.
4. Capture and inspect a gameplay screenshot if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/main.gd`: Menus, environment, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, and newly added race completion/rain effects.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural car construction and driving behavior.
- `project.godot`: Godot project and renderer/display configuration.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene referencing the gameplay script.
- `README.md`: Still generic; needs game and build instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Godot executable was not available at the last check.
- Recent race-flow edits have not been validated; inspect them before building on them.

202: 		var tangent := (p1 - p0).normalized()
203: 		var side := Vector3(-tangent.z, 0, tangent.x) * width
204: 		var a := p0 + side + Vector3.UP * y
205: 		var b := p0 - side + Vector3.UP * y
206: 		var c := p1 + side + Vector3.UP * y
207: 		var d := p1 - side + Vector3.UP * y
208: 		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(a); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c)
209: 		st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(c); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(b); st.set_normal(Vector3.UP); st.add_vertex(d)
210: 	st.generate_normals()

## Objective
- Build a playable 3D Android landscape racing prototype, ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026, in Godot, with source code and Android APK/AAB build instructions.

## Requirements
- Include driving controls, AI rivals, multiple tracks, race completion and rewards, 10 cars, paint and engine upgrades, wheel customization, garage, game modes, and graphics/frame-rate settings.
- Support desktop play and provide Android APK/Google Play AAB build instructions.
- Multiplayer is a future update, not implemented online.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer.
- Generate vehicles and environments procedurally; no external assets have been added.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created Godot project setup, main scene, procedural cars and environment, menus, garage, settings, touch controls, AI, and HUD.
- Added countdown, pause/resume input handling, opponent progress tracking, results/reward screen, rain effect, race floor collision, and several race-flow fixes in `scripts/main.gd`.

### Active
- Inspect and validate recent `scripts/main.gd` edits, especially race progress, countdown, results cleanup, and mode flow.
- Update `README.md` with desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions.

### Blocked
- Godot runtime validation and gameplay capture have not been performed; no `godot` or `godot4` executable was found.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `scripts/main.gd` for syntax/runtime issues, including the newly added rain and results code.
2. Run/import the project with Godot 4 when available and fix parser or runtime errors.
3. Add desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions to `README.md`.
4. Capture and inspect a gameplay screenshot if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/main.gd`: Menus, environment, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, results, and rain effect.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural car construction and driving behavior.
- `project.godot`: Godot project and renderer/display configuration.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene referencing the gameplay script.
- `README.md`: Still generic; needs game and build instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear as untracked in `git status`.
- The last review found `scripts/main.gd` implements a countdown that returns before normal processing, a race finish/reward screen, and a rain effect, but these edits remain unvalidated.

# ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026

A procedural 3D street-racing prototype made with Godot 4 and the GL Compatibility renderer. Cars and tracks are generated from built-in meshes; no external art assets are required.

## Play on desktop

1. Install **Godot 4.2 or newer**.
2. Open this repository's `project.godot` in Godot (or import the project from the Project Manager).
3. Press **F6** to run the current scene or **F5** to run the project.

**Keyboard controls:** W / ↑ accelerate, S / ↓ brake/reverse, A / ← and D / → steer, Space drift, Shift nitro, Esc pause/resume. On a touch device, use the on-screen controls. The game is designed for landscape orientation.

Choose a mode and track from the home screen. The garage includes 10 unlockable cars, paint choices, engine upgrades, and wheel-style selection. Race progress and credits are saved locally. Online multiplayer is not implemented; it is shown as a future-update option.

## Export an Android APK or Google Play AAB

You need Godot 4.2+, the matching Godot export templates, and the Android export toolchain. Install Android Studio or the Android command-line tools, an Android SDK platform/build tools version supported by your Godot release, and a compatible JDK (Godot's current Android export documentation lists the supported versions). In Godot, configure **Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android** with the paths to the Java SDK and Android SDK, then install templates through **Editor → Manage Export Templates**.

1. Open the project and choose **Project → Export**.
2. Add an **Android** preset. Set a unique reverse-DNS package name (for example, `com.yourstudio.ultimatestreetracers`), app name, version, and any signing details required for your distribution. Keep landscape orientation enabled.
3. For a directly installable build, select the Android preset and click **Export Project** to create an `.apk`. For local testing, a debug APK is usually sufficient; enable/install the debug keystore as prompted.
4. For Google Play, enable **Gradle Build** in the Android preset if the Godot version/toolchain requires it, then export a **release `.aab`** with your own release keystore. Keep the keystore and passwords private and backed up; do not commit them to this repository.
5. Test the exported build on a physical Android device, especially touch controls, safe-area/layout behavior, and performance on the intended device range.

The repository currently contains the Godot project but no committed Android export preset or signing key. Export setting names and SDK/JDK requirements can vary slightly by Godot version; refer to the official [Godot Android export documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export וא) and Android's [Play App Signing](https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/app-signing) guidance for current release requirements.

## Project layout

- `project.godot` — display, renderer, and project settings.
- `scenes/main.tscn` — main scene.
- `scripts/main.gd` — menus, procedural tracks, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, and results.
- `scripts/car.gd` — procedural car visuals and arcade driving behavior.

Runtime validation and Android export have not yet been performed in this environment; use the steps above to run and verify the prototype with your installed Godot toolchain.

64: 	if using_nitro and nitro > 0.0 and throttle > 0.0:

66: 		nitro = maxf(0.0, nitro - 31.0 * delta)

70: 	var turn_rate := (1.45 if drifting else 1.12) * handling
71: 	if absf(speed) > 0.4:

20: # ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026
21: 
22: A procedural 3D street-racing prototype made with Godot 4 and the GL Compatibility renderer. Cars and tracks are generated from built-in meshes; no external art assets are required.
23: 
24: ## Play on desktop
25: 
26: 1. Install **Godot 4.2 or newer**.
27: 2. Open this repository's `project.godot` in Godot (or import the project from the Project Manager).
28: 3. Press **F6** to run the current scene or **F5** to run the project.
29: 
30: **Keyboard controls:** W / ↑ accelerate, S / ↓ brake/reverse, A / ← and D / → steer, Space drift, Shift nitro, Esc pause/resume. On a touch device, use the on-screen controls. The game is designed for landscape orientation.
31: 
32: Choose a mode and track from the home screen. The garage includes 10 unlockable cars, paint choices, engine upgrades, and wheel-style selection. Race progress and credits are saved locally. Online multiplayer is not implemented; it is shown as a future-update option.
33: 
34: ## Export an Android APK or Google Play AAB
35: 
36: You need Godot 4.2+, the matching Godot export templates, and the Android export toolchain. Install Android Studio or the Android command-line tools, an Android SDK platform/build tools version supported by your Godot release, and a compatible JDK (Godot's current Android export documentation lists the supported versions). In Godot, configure **Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android** with the paths to the Java SDK and Android SDK, then install templates through **Editor → Manage Export Templates**.
37: 
38: 1. Open the project and choose **Project → Export**.
39: 2. Add an **Android** preset. Set a unique reverse-DNS package name (for example, `com.yourstudio.ultimatestreetracers`), app name, version, and any signing details required for your distribution. Keep landscape orientation enabled.
40: 3. For a directly installable build, select the Android preset and click **Export Project** to create an `.apk`. For local testing, a debug APK is usually sufficient; enable/install the debug keystore as prompted.
41: 4. For Google Play, enable **Gradle Build** in the Android preset if the Godot version/toolchain requires it, then export a **release `.aab`** with your own release keystore. Keep the keystore and passwords private and backed up; do not commit them to this repository.
42: 5. Test the exported build on a physical Android device, especially touch controls, safe-area/layout behavior, and performance on the intended device range.
43: 
44: The repository currently contains the Godot project but no committed Android export preset or signing key. Export setting names and SDK/JDK requirements can vary slightly by Godot version; refer to the official [Godot Android export documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.html) and Android's [Play App Signing](https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/app-signing) guidance for current release requirements.
45: 
46: ## Project layout
47: 
48: - `project.godot` — display, renderer, and project settings.
49: - `scenes/main.tscn` — main scene.
50: - `scripts/main.gd` — menus, procedural tracks, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, and results.
51: - `scripts/car.gd` — procedural car visuals and arcade driving behavior.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D Android landscape racing prototype, ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026, in Godot, with desktop support and Android APK/AAB build guidance.

## Requirements
- Include driving controls, AI rivals, multiple tracks and modes, race results and rewards, 10 cars, paint/engine upgrades, wheel customization, garage, and graphics/frame-rate settings.
- Support desktop play and document Android APK/Google Play AAB export.
- Multiplayer is a future update, not implemented online.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer.
- Generate cars and environments procedurally; no external assets are used.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented procedural cars and tracks, menus, garage, settings, touch/keyboard controls, AI, countdown, pause/resume, HUD, progression, results, and rain effect.
- Added desktop controls and Android APK/AAB export instructions to `README.md`.
- Corrected road ribbon triangle winding in `scripts/main.gd`.
- Removed redundant Escape-key polling from `_process`; Escape pause/resume is handled in `_unhandled_input`.

### Active
- Validate race flow and scripts with Godot 4, including progress, countdown, results cleanup, and mode flow.

### Blocked
- Runtime validation and gameplay capture remain pending; no Godot 4 executable was found.

## Next Move
1. Run/import the project with Godot 4 and resolve parser or runtime errors.
2. Test gameplay, race completion/rewards, mode behavior, and Android export on target devices when a Godot toolchain is available.
3. Capture and inspect gameplay if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/main.gd`: Menus, tracks, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, results, and rain.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural car construction and driving behavior.
- `project.godot`: Godot project and renderer/display configuration.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene.
- `README.md`: Desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in git status.
- The prototype has not been runtime-validated or exported to Android.

43: 			wheel.rotation.z = PI / 2
44: 			wheel_nodes.append(wheel)
45: 			var hub := _cylinder(0.2, 0.29, Vector3(x * 1.005, 0.43, z), Color("#a9b5c3"))
46: 			hub.rotation.z = PI / 2
47: 	# Headlamps and signature side accent
48: 	for x in [-0.62, 0.62]:
49: 		_box(Vector3(0.38, 0.12, 0.09), Vector3(x, 0.95, -2.12), Color("#dff7ff"), 0.1, 0.8)

52: func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
53: 	var forward := -global_transform.basis.z
54: 	var grounded := is_on_floor()
55: 	var accel := acceleration * (1.0 if grounded else 0.38)
56: 	if throttle > 0.0:
57: 		speed = move_toward(speed, max_speed, accel * throttle * delta)
58: 	elif throttle < 0.0:
59: 		speed = move_toward(speed, -max_speed * 0.25, accel * 0.65 * -throttle * delta)
60: 	else:
61: 		speed = move_toward(speed, 0.0, (3.4 if drifting else 5.2) * delta)
62: 	if braking:
63: 		speed = move_toward(speed, 0.0, 36.0 * delta)
64: 	if using_nitro and nitro > 0.0 and throttle > 0.0:
65: 		speed = minf(speed + 24.0 * delta, max_speed * 1.26)
66: 		nitro = maxf(0.0, nitro - 31.0 * delta)
67: 	else:
68: 		nitro = minf(100.0, nitro + 9.0 * delta)
69: 	var speed_ratio := clampf(absf(speed) / max_speed, 0.0, 1.2)
70: 	var turn_rate := (1.45 if drifting else 1.12) * handling
71: 	if absf(speed) > 0.4:
72: 		rotation.y += steer * turn_rate * (0.32 + speed_ratio * 0.9) * delta * signf(speed)
73: 	var side_velocity := velocity - forward * velocity.dot(forward)
74: 	var grip := 2.4 if drifting else 9.5
75: 	velocity = forward * speed + side_velocity * exp(-grip * delta)
76: 	if not grounded:
77: 		velocity.y -= 20.0 * delta
78: 	else:
79: 		velocity.y = -0.5
80: 	move_and_slide()
81: 	if get_slide_collision_count() > 0:
82: 		speed *= 0.82
83: 	for wheel in wheel_nodes:
84: 		wheel.rotate_x(-speed * delta * 0.7)

20: # ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026
21: 
22: A procedural 3D street-racing prototype made with Godot 4 and the GL Compatibility renderer. Cars and tracks are generated from built-in meshes; no external art assets are required.
23: 
24: ## Play on desktop
25: 
26: 1. Install **Godot 4.2 or newer**.
27: 2. Open this repository's `project.godot` in Godot (or import the project from the Project Manager).
28: 3. Press **F6** to run the current scene or **F5** to run the project.
29: 
30: **Keyboard controls:** W / ↑ accelerate, S / ↓ brake/reverse, A / ← and D / → steer, Space drift, Shift nitro, Esc pause/resume. On a touch device, use the on-screen controls. The game is designed for landscape orientation.
31: 
32: Choose a mode and track from the home screen. The garage includes 10 unlockable cars, paint choices, engine upgrades, and wheel-style selection. Race progress and credits are saved locally. Online multiplayer is not implemented; it is shown as a future-update option.
33: 
34: ## Export an Android APK or Google Play AAB
35: 
36: You need Godot 4.2+, the matching Godot export templates, and the Android export toolchain. Install Android Studio or the Android command-line tools, an Android SDK platform/build tools version supported by your Godot release, and a compatible JDK (Godot's current Android export documentation lists the supported versions). In Godot, configure **Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android** with the paths to the Java SDK and Android SDK, then install templates through **Editor → Manage Export Templates**.
37: 
38: 1. Open the project and choose **Project → Export**.
39: 2. Add an **Android** preset. Set a unique reverse-DNS package name (for example, `com.yourstudio.ultimatestreetracers`), app name, version, and any signing details required for your distribution. Keep landscape orientation enabled.
40: 3. For a directly installable build, select the Android preset and click **Export Project** to create an `.apk`. For local testing, a debug APK is usually sufficient; enable/install the debug keystore as prompted.
41: 4. For Google Play, enable **Gradle Build** in the Android preset if the Godot version/toolchain requires it, then export a **release `.aab`** with your own release keystore. Keep the keystore and passwords private and backed up; do not commit them to this repository.
42: 5. Test the exported build on a physical Android device, especially touch controls, safe-area/layout behavior, and performance on the intended device range.
43: 
44: The repository currently contains the Godot project but no committed Android export preset or signing key. Export setting names and SDK/JDK requirements can vary slightly by Godot version; refer to the official [Godot Android export documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.html) and Android's [Play App Signing](https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/app-signing) guidance for current release requirements.
45: 
46: ## Project layout
47: 
48: - `project.godot` — display, renderer, and project settings.
49: - `scenes/main.tscn` — main scene.
50: - `scripts/main.gd` — menus, procedural tracks, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, and results.
51: - `scripts/car.gd` — procedural car visuals and arcade driving behavior.
52:

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a playable 3D Android landscape racing prototype, ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026, in Godot, with desktop support and Android APK/AAB build guidance.

## Requirements
- Include driving controls, AI rivals, multiple tracks and modes, race results and rewards, 10 cars, paint/engine upgrades, wheel customization, garage, and graphics/frame-rate settings.
- Support desktop play and document Android APK/Google Play AAB export.
- Multiplayer is a future update, not implemented online.

## Decisions
- Use Godot 4 with the GL Compatibility renderer.
- Generate cars and environments procedurally; no external assets are used.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented procedural cars and tracks, menus, garage, settings, touch/keyboard controls, AI, countdown, pause/resume, HUD, progression, results, and rain effect.
- Added desktop controls and Android APK/AAB export instructions to `README.md`.
- Corrected road ribbon triangle winding in `scripts/main.gd`.
- Removed redundant Escape-key polling from `_process`; Escape pause/resume is handled in `_unhandled_input`.

### Active
- Validate race flow and scripts with Godot 4, including progress, countdown, results cleanup, and mode flow.
- Godot 4.7.2 was identified as the latest release, with a downloadable Linux x86_64 archive available; it has not yet been downloaded or run.

### Blocked
- Runtime validation and gameplay capture remain pending until a Godot 4 executable is available.

## Next Move
1. Download and run Godot 4.7.2 headlessly to import/validate the project and resolve any parser or runtime errors.
2. Test gameplay, race completion/rewards, mode behavior, and Android export on target devices when a Godot toolchain is available.
3. Capture and inspect gameplay if a runnable environment becomes available.

## Relevant Files
- `scripts/main.gd`: Menus, tracks, race flow, AI, HUD, progression, results, and rain.
- `scripts/car.gd`: Procedural car construction and driving behavior.
- `project.godot`: Godot project and renderer/display configuration.
- `scenes/main.tscn`: Main scene.
- `README.md`: Desktop play and Android APK/AAB export instructions.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in git status.
- The prototype has not been runtime-validated or exported to Android.

20: # ULTIMATE STREET RACERS 2026
21: 
22: A procedural 3D street-racing prototype made with Godot 4 and the GL Compatibility renderer. Cars and tracks are generated from built-in meshes; no external art assets are required.
23: 
24: ## Play on desktop
25: 
26: 1. Install **Godot 4.2 or newer**.
27: 2. Open this repository's `project.godot` in Godot (or import the project from the Project Manager).
28: 3. Press **F6** to run the current scene or **F5** to run the project.
29: 
30: **Keyboard controls:** W / ↑ accelerate, S / ↓ brake/reverse, A / ← and D / → steer, Space drift, Shift nitro, Esc pause/resume. On a touch device, use the on-screen controls. The game is designed for landscape orientation.
31: 
32: Choose a mode and track from the home screen. The garage includes 10 unlockable cars, paint choices, engine upgrades, and wheel-style selection. Race progress and credits are saved locally. Online multiplayer is not implemented; it is shown as a future-update option.
33: 
34: ## Export an Android APK or Google Play AAB
35: 
36: You need Godot 4.2+, the matching Godot export templates, and the Android export toolchain. Install Android Studio or the Android command-line tools, an Android SDK platform/build tools version supported by your Godot release, and a compatible JDK (Godot's current Android export documentation lists the supported versions). In Godot, configure **Editor → Editor Settings → Export → Android** with the paths to the Java SDK and Android SDK, then install templates through **Editor → Manage Export Templates**.
37: 
38: 1. Open the project and choose **Project → Export**.
39: 2. Add an **Android** preset. Set a unique reverse-DNS package name (for example, `com.yourstudio.ultimatestreetracers`), app name, version, and any signing details required for your distribution. Keep landscape orientation enabled.
40: 3. For a directly installable build, select the Android preset and click **Export Project** to create an `.apk`. For local testing, a debug APK is usually sufficient; enable/install the debug keystore as prompted.
41: 4. For Google Play, enable **Gradle Build** in the Android preset if the Godot version/toolchain requires it, then export a **release `.aab`** with your own release keystore. Keep the keystore and passwords private and backed up; do not commit them to this repository.
42: 5. Test the exported build on a physical Android device, especially touch controls, safe-area/layout behavior, and performance on the intended device range.
43: 
44: The repository currently contains the Godot project but no committed Android export preset or signing key. Export setting names and SDK/JDK requirements can vary slightly by Godot version; refer to the official [Godot Android export documentation](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_android.html) and Android's [Play App Signing](https://developer.android.com/studio/publish/app-signing) guidance for current release requirements.
45:
